Frequently Asked Questions
With thousands of podcasts, radio stations, and audiobooks for every interest, iVoox offers the largest Spanish-language audio catalog. Founded in 2010, it has been driving the podcast industry in Spain and Latin America for more than a decade with an ecosystem designed for creators, listeners, and brands. It is also a pioneer in promoting monetization in the Spanish-speaking podcast world, being the only platform that allows podcasters to generate income and grow their audience at the same time.
Yes, iVoox is a free on-demand audio platform for both listeners and creators. It allows you to listen to, download, and share thousands of podcasts, radio stations, and audiobooks at no cost, whether from the app, the website, your car, or even your smartwatch. In addition, through iVoox Podcasters, creators can publish their content for free and start growing their audience from day one.
From the iVoox app, tap the download button (down-arrow icon) on the episode you want and listen offline whenever and wherever you like.
From the website, click the three dots (“…”) on the episode page, select “Download,” then right-click the “Download on Mac” button. Finally, choose “Save link as…” to enjoy it on your computer
  1. Sign up or log in to your iVoox account.
  2. From the welcome page, click + New show, then add your cover art and fill out the podcast details.
  3. Upload or drag and drop the file for your first episode.
  4. Complete its information: title, description, category, tags… Add a cover image, choose the format and language, and click publish.
  5. Share it on social media and grow your audience!.
View more
If you host your podcast on iVoox, you can distribute it on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and other platforms with a single click and for free. To do so, just go to your creator area and look for the self-publishing option in your podcast's file or in the sharing modal. Forget about manually managing distribution on each app and reach millions of listeners from one place!
View more
You can monetize your podcast on iVoox in several ways. With fan subscriptions, you’ll receive recurring support from your listeners by offering exclusive, ad-free content—right where your audience already listens, on iVoox and on Spotify—without needing to duplicate your podcast! You can also earn money through advertising campaigns and sponsorships with major brands through AdVoices, our audio marketplace connecting podcasters and advertisers.
If you publish exclusively, you can also earn money with iVoox Plus, obtaining income from plays and your contribution to the catalog. You can also join iVoox Originals, our exclusive catalog where we will help you professionalize your content, ensuring listeners and a committed community. In addition, you can complement your income with dynamic ads and our affiliate program, designed to monetize even with smaller audiences.
The most listened to podcasts on iVoox cover topics such as mystery, humor, history, current affairs, and true crime. Highlights include Días Extraños, where Santiago Camacho explores major historical mysteries; Nadie Sabe Nada, in which Berto Romero and Andreu Buenafuente improvise on everyday life; La Ruina, where guests share their most embarrassing stories; Cuarto Milenio, where Iker Jiménez and Carmen Porter delve into the paranormal; and Crónicas de la Calle Morgue, a must-listen for true-crime fans.
View more
It’s super easy! To subscribe, open the podcast page and select Subscribe. You’ll be able to follow it, receive notifications for every new episode, and keep it handy in your Subscriptions list—both in the app and on the website.
Yes. If you’re subscribed to a podcast, we’ll send you notifications whenever a new episode is published so you don’t miss a thing. You can turn these alerts on or off from the app or the website according to your preferences.
With the iVoox app, you can listen to, download, and share thousands of podcasts, radio stations, and audiobooks in Spanish, free of charge and from any device. Receive personalized recommendations, create custom playlists, and enjoy the best content offline. Driving? We'll accompany you on your journeys thanks to CarPlay and Android Auto support.
